project.name: MD2PDF
project.description: Web app that loads/edits Markdown and renders it live as paginated A4-style pages with KaTeX math support
project.author: Philip Leichauer

fromProjectPlan: Canvas-based markdown preview using integrated canvadoc-typesetter engine
Split-pane UI with draggable divider, zoom controls, and theme toggle
Multi-document workflow with upload, select, rename, close, and page counts
Client-side PDF export (no headless browser required)
